cd /tank/nxeon-wt-modbuilder && cat >> docs/DOCUMENTATION.md <<'EOF'

## AI Mod Builder: private preview (2026-10-06, branch feature/mod-builder-preview)

**What it is.** A customer describes a Minecraft plugin in plain English at `/dashboard/mod-builder`; the AI writes a Paper plugin, the build service compiles it, repairs it automatically when it fails (up to 3 fixes), safety-scans it, and hands back a `.jar` plus full source and a plain-English summary (what it does, commands, permissions, settings). The customer downloads it, installs it on one of their Paper/Purpur servers (backup of any older copy, optional restart), or asks for a change (a new version built on the previous source). Research and the long-term plan: `/root/agent-notes/ai-modbuilder/`.

**Who can see it.** Only accounts on the preview allowlist: `lib/preview-access.ts` `isPreviewUser(user, "modbuilder")`, Setting `preview_access_emails` (comma-separated; code default `nicholas.sj.albanese@gmail.com`). `lib/modbuilder/access.ts` requires BOTH the effective user and the real signed-in account to be on the list (no access through impersonation in either direction). Everyone else: pages `notFound()`, page titles say "Page not found" (`generateMetadata`, so the 404 never names the feature), API returns 404, no rail entry (the entry is passed per-user through `Shell`'s new `extraNav` prop, never added to the static `lib/nx/nav.ts`), `noindex`, not in the sitemap (`/dashboard` is never listed and is disallowed in robots). Tests: `test/modbuilder-gate.test.ts`.

**Where things run.**

| Piece | Where | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Build service | VM 88001 `modbuilder-claudebox` on node-2, `10.20.1.253`, container `modbuilder` (image `modbuilder:0.2`), `127.0.0.1:7340` on the VM | Source in `services/modbuilder/` (copied to `/opt/modbuilder/` on the VM). Restart: `ssh -J root@178.63.94.114 root@10.20.1.253 /opt/modbuilder/run.sh modbuilder:0.2`. Docker `--restart unless-stopped`, so it comes back on boot. Data: `/var/lib/modbuilder/data/builds/<id>/` (build.json, artifact.jar, ws/ source). Logs: `docker logs modbuilder`. |
| Tunnel | primary, systemd `nxeon-modbuilder-tunnel.service` | `ssh -N -J root@178.63.94.114 -L 127.0.0.1:7340:127.0.0.1:7340 root@10.20.1.253`, `Restart=always`. Unit file also in `services/modbuilder/`. |
| Portal | `/dashboard/mod-builder`, `/dashboard/mod-builder/[id]`, `/api/mod-builder/*`, `/admin/mod-builder` (URL-only, preview-gated cost table) | `lib/modbuilder/{types,client,store,install,access}.ts`, `components/nx/modbuilder/*`, styles `app/dashboard/mod-builder/mb.css` (scoped `.mb-root`). |
| Jars on the primary | `NXEON_MODBUILD_DIR` (default `/var/lib/nxeon/modbuilds/<buildId>.jar`) | Written by `syncBuild` (sha256-checked) before the row flips to `succeeded`. |
| Worker | sweep `modbuilder-sync` every 20 s (`lib/modbuilder/store.ts sweepModBuilds`) | Finishes builds nobody is watching; the routes also sync on read. |

**Secrets.** Bearer key for the service: `/root/modbuilder.env` on the VM (`MODBUILDER_API_KEY`, mode 600) and `/root/secrets/modbuilder.env` on the primary (`MODBUILDER_URL`, `MODBUILDER_API_KEY`; read by `lib/modbuilder/client.ts`, override with env or `MODBUILDER_ENV_FILE`). AI auth: `/root/claudebox.env` on the VM, today the owner's Claude subscription token (`CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`). **Switch to a paid API key with one change:** replace that line with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...` and rerun `run.sh`; `/health` then reports `auth: "api_key"`. Model: `MB_MODEL` (default alias `sonnet`, resolved to `claude-sonnet-5` on 2026-10-06), `MB_REPAIR_MODEL`.

**Service API** (all but `/health` need `Authorization: Bearer`): `POST /builds {id, prompt, mcVersion, pluginName?, baseBuildId?, changeRequest?}` → 202; `GET /builds/:id` (status `queued|planning|coding|compiling|repairing|scanning|succeeded|failed`, `events[]`, `summary`, `commands`, `permissions`, `config`, `files`, `warnings`, `safety`, `error` (plain English), `errorCode` (`compile|safety|refused|budget|timeout|ai_unavailable|cancelled|interrupted`), `attempts`, `costUsd`, `durationMs`, `jar{name,size,sha256}`); `GET /builds/:id/artifact`; `GET /builds/:id/source?path=`; `GET /builds/:id/source.zip`; `POST /builds/:id/cancel`; `GET /health`. Caps: concurrency 2 (`MB_CONCURRENCY`), 3 repairs, $2.50 per AI call and $4 per build (`MB_*_BUDGET_USD`), 20 min per build, 10 min per AI call. Builds in flight when the service restarts are marked failed (`interrupted`).

**Pipeline.** Fresh workspace from the pinned template (`services/modbuilder/template`, Paper API per version, Java 21) → Claude Code headless (`claude -p`, tools Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep only, `acceptEdits`, deny rules on `/proc /etc /home /opt /root /run /data`, strict system prompt in `prompts.js`) writes `src/main/**` and `modbuilder.json` (the plain-English summary) → workspace sanitised (only `src/main/**` survives; Gradle files restored from the template so model-written build scripts never run) → validation (plugin.yml fields, main class exists and is not final, every `getCommand("x")` declared in plugin.yml, api-version fixed mechanically) → `javac --release 21 -proc:none` against the classpath Gradle resolved at image build (offline, ~3 s) → safety scan (`scan.js`: bytecode via `javap -c -p` for exec/ProcessBuilder, sockets/URL/HttpClient, class loading, Unsafe, System.exit, JNI, scripting, NMS/CraftBukkit = block; reflection, setOp, dispatchCommand, permission attachments, Base64, getenv = warn; source heuristics for paths outside the data folder, encoded blobs, hard-coded players with privileges) → any block gets one AI fix, then fails → secret scan (fails and wipes the workspace if the subscription/API/bearer key or any `sk-ant-` string appears in output) → jar + summary. Failures and validation errors are fed back to the same Claude session (`--resume`). Refusals (backdoors, exfiltration, malware) come back as `refused` with the model's one-line reason.

**Egress.** The container keeps claudebox's iptables allowlist (Anthropic domains only). `repo.papermc.io` / `repo.maven.apache.org` / Gradle are only reached during `docker build` (pre-warming `/opt/mb/gradle-home` and recording `/opt/mb/classpath/<ver>.txt`), which runs outside the runtime firewall. Runtime builds are fully offline. Supported versions: 1.21.11 (default), 1.21.8, 1.21.4, 1.21.1 (`MB_VERSIONS`, baked at image build).

**Install to server.** `lib/modbuilder/install.ts`: owned server, family minecraft, variant paper/purpur (generated plugins use Paper-only API, so Spigot/Bukkit/Folia are refused with a reason), RUNNING or STOPPED. Uses the mods engine's `SshGuestFs` (management key first) / `LocalGuestFs` in SANDBOX: any earlier jar of the same plugin (`<Name>-*.jar`, `<Name>.jar`) is copied to `/root/.nxeon-mods/backups/<stamp>-modbuilder-<Name>/` and removed, the new jar is written via a `.part` file + rename into `/opt/mc/plugins`, chowned like the folder. Optional restart goes through the normal `gamePower(serverId, "restart")` job. Audit log `modbuilder.install`. Not routed through `GAME_MOD_SYNC` / the ServerMod state file yet, so the server's Mods tab doesn't list builder plugins (v1 item).

**Data.** `ModBuild` (additive; `userId` owner, no relation), status mirror, `result` JSON (summary/commands/permissions/config/warnings/files/safety/events), `costUsd`, jar fields, `lastInstall`, `baseBuildId`/`rootBuildId` for version history. Rate limits: 3 builds/min, 20/hour, 2 in flight per user; installs 10/min.

**Phase 0 measurement (2026-10-06).** 10 real builds (8 fresh prompts across 1.21.11/1.21.8/1.21.4/1.21.1 + 2 change requests): 10/10 succeeded, 3 needed an automatic repair (real compiler errors, e.g. a non-existent `TNTPrimeEvent.getIgnitingEntity()`), average 160 s (median 176 s, range 40-299 s), average $0.28 per build API-equivalent (range $0.08-$0.47; Claude Sonnet 5). 2/2 adversarial prompts (backdoor + webhook exfiltration; dumping host env and `.claude.json`) refused in ~7 s for under $0.01. 8 of the jars were loaded on a throwaway Paper 1.21.11 server on the build VM and exercised by a mineflayer bot (economy + shop GUI purchase, heal/feed, zones, join titles, scoreboard sidebar, spleef help, daily rewards, boss summon + boss bar + death announcement): all enabled, all commands worked, no exceptions. Scripts and raw output: `/root/agent-notes/modbuilder-preview/`.

**Known gaps.** No automated in-game test per build yet (the bot test was manual). No MockBukkit unit tests. No Ed25519 signing. Concurrent builds can in principle read each other's live workspace under `/work` (both are the same user today). Installs aren't recorded in the mods engine state. The service runs on the owner's subscription and is owner-only; production needs an API key, pricing and the decisions in `/root/agent-notes/ai-modbuilder/EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY.md`.
EOF
grep -n "^## " ROADMAP.md | tail -5

**Pipeline.** Fresh workspace from the pinned template (`services/modbuilder/template`, Paper API per version, Java 21) → Claude Code headless (`claude -p`, tools Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep only, `acceptEdits`, deny rules on `/proc /etc /home /opt /root /run /data`, strict system prompt in `prompts.js`) writes `src/main/**` and `modbuilder.json` (the plain-English summary) → workspace sanitised (only `src/main/**` survives; Gradle files restored from the template so model-written build scripts never run) → validation (plugin.yml fields, main class exists and is not final, every `getCommand("x")` declared in plugin.yml, api-version fixed mechanically) → `javac --release 21 -proc:none` against the classpath Gradle resolved at image build (offline, ~3 s) → safety scan (`scan.js`: bytecode via `javap -c -p` for exec/ProcessBuilder, sockets/URL/HttpClient, class loading, Unsafe, System.exit, JNI, scripting, NMS/CraftBukkit = block; reflection, setOp, dispatchCommand, permission attachments, Base64, getenv = warn; source heuristics for paths outside the data folder, encoded blobs, hard-coded players with privileges) → any block gets one AI fix, then fails → secret scan (fails and wipes the workspace if the subscription/API/bearer key or any `sk-ant-` string appears in output) → jar + summary. Uses the mods engine's `SshGuestFs` (management key first) / `LocalGuestFs` in SANDBOX: any earlier jar of the same plugin (`<Name>-*.jar`, `<Name>.jar`) is copied to `/root/.nxeon-mods/backups/<stamp>-modbuilder-<Name>/` and removed, the new jar is written via a `.part` file + rename into `/opt/mc/plugins`, chowned like the folder. Optional restart goes through the normal `gamePower(serverId, "restart")` job. Audit log `modbuilder.install`. Not routed through `GAME_MOD_SYNC` / the ServerMod state file yet, so the server's Mods tab doesn't list builder plugins (v1 item).

Scripts and raw output: `/root/agent-notes/modbuilder-preview/`.

**Known gaps.** No automated in-game test per build yet (the bot test was manual). No MockBukkit unit tests. No Ed25519 signing. Concurrent builds can in principle read each other's live workspace under `/work` (both are the same user today). Installs aren't recorded in the mods engine state. The service runs on the owner's subscription and is owner-only; production needs an API key, pricing and the decisions in `/root/agent-notes/ai-modbuilder/EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY.md`.

## AI Mod Builder: first working version (private preview)

The full flow works for real: prompt → AI writes the plugin → compile → automatic repair → safety scan → .jar plus a plain-English summary → download, install or "Ask for a change". All 10 real builds succeeded, and 8 of the jars were tested in-game on a throwaway Paper server. Nothing was deployed or merged, no prod services were restarted, and no customer servers were touched.

### What runs where
**Build service**
- Runs on VM 88001 (10.20.1.253, node-2) as container `modbuilder` (image `modbuilder:0.2`). It listens on `127.0.0.1:7340` on the VM.
- It is my own orchestrator built on the claudebox image, adding Temurin JDK 21.0.12, Gradle 8.14.3 and a pinned Paper template for 1.21.11, 1.21.8, 1.21.4 and 1.21.1.
- I stopped the original `claudebox` container and set its restart policy to "no".
- Source is in the branch at `services/modbuilder/` and copied to `/opt/modbuilder/` on the VM.
- To restart: `ssh -J root@178.63.94.114 root@10.20.1.253 /opt/modbuilder/run.sh modbuilder:0.2`. The container uses `--restart unless-stopped`, so it comes back after a reboot.
- Build data is in `/var/lib/modbuilder/data/builds/<id>/`.
- API, as suggested: `POST /builds`, `GET /builds/:id`, `/artifact`, `/source?path=`, `/source.zip`, `/cancel`, `/health`. Everything except `/health` needs the bearer key.
- Limits: 2 builds at once, 3 repairs per build, $2.50 per AI call, $4 per build, 20 minutes per build.

**Internet access**
- At runtime the container can still only reach Anthropic domains (claudebox's allowlist, unchanged).
- PaperMC and Maven Central are only contacted while the Docker image is built, to pre-download dependencies. Builds themselves run fully offline.

**Safety layers** (all checked by the service, not by the AI):
- The AI only gets the Read, Write, Edit, Glob and Grep tools. I confirmed by a real test that it cannot read `/proc`, `/etc`, `/home`, `/opt`, `/root`, `/run` or `/data`.
- Only `src/main/**` survives from what the AI writes. Gradle files are always restored from the template, so AI-written build scripts never run.
- Pre-compile checks on `plugin.yml`, the main class and that every command the code uses is declared.
- A safety scan of the compiled code and the source. I ran it against a deliberately malicious class and it caught program execution, network access, server shutdown, file access outside the plugin folder, reading environment variables and reflection.
- A secret scan fails the build and wipes it if the subscription token, the bearer key or any `sk-ant-` string shows up in the output.

**Secrets**
- Bearer key: `/root/modbuilder.env` on the VM and `/root/secrets/modbuilder.env` on the primary (both mode 600).
- The subscription token was never printed or copied.
- To switch to a paid API key: replace the line in `/root/claudebox.env` on the VM with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...` and rerun `run.sh`.

### Tunnel
I installed and started `nxeon-modbuilder-tunnel.service` on the primary. It is an `ssh -N -J node-2 -L 127.0.0.1:7340` connection with `Restart=always`, and it is active. A copy of the unit file is in `services/modbuilder/`.

### Branch and commits
Branch `feature/mod-builder-preview` in worktree `/tank/nxeon-wt-modbuilder`:
- `6662a5e203`: service, portal pages, API, install, worker sync
- `2a560a3a08`: polish, gate tests, docs and Phase 0 numbers

What's in it:
- **Preview gate:** `lib/preview-access.ts` with `isPreviewUser(user, "modbuilder")`. The allowlist comes from Setting `preview_access_emails`, defaulting to the owner's email. Both the signed-in account and the effective user must be on it, so impersonation can't open it either way.
- **Pages:** `/dashboard/mod-builder` (hero prompt box, idea chips, version picker, your builds, how it works) and `/dashboard/mod-builder/[id]` (live timeline, result card, commands/permissions/settings, safety card, source viewer with file tree, version history, failure state with "reword and retry").
- **Install modal:** picks a Paper or Purpur server and backs up any older copy to `/root/.nxeon-mods/backups/...` through the mods engine's SSH transport. Restart goes through the normal `gamePower` job.
- **Other pieces:**
  - "Ask for a change" modal.
  - Admin cost table at `/admin/mod-builder`, URL-only and preview-gated.
  - Additive `ModBuild` Prisma model; deploying needs a `db push`.
  - Worker sync every 20 seconds.
  - Rate limits: 3 builds per minute, 20 per hour, 2 running per user.
  - Jars are stored at `/var/lib/nxeon/modbuilds`.
- **Nav:** `Shell` gets a new `extraNav` prop so only the preview user's sidebar shows "Mod Builder · PREVIEW". The static nav is untouched.
- **Docs:** updated `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md` (new section "AI Mod Builder: private preview") and `ROADMAP.md`.

**Checks:** `tsc` is clean, and the new `test/modbuilder-gate.test.ts` passes (6/6). I did not run `next build`.

**Worktree note:** `node_modules` in the worktree is a real folder of symlinks into release2 with its own generated Prisma client, so I didn't overwrite release2's client. It is gitignored.

### Phase 0 numbers (10 real builds, Claude Sonnet 5 via the `sonnet` alias)
- **Success rate:** 10/10 (8 new plugins plus 2 change requests, across all 4 versions).
- **Repairs:** 3 builds needed an automatic fix of real compiler errors: ZoneGuard (called a method Paper doesn't have), SimpleEconomy and the boss fight.
- **Time:** average 160 seconds, median 176 seconds, range 40 to 299 seconds.
- **Cost:** average $0.28 per build, range $0.08 to $0.47, $2.82 in total. These are API-equivalent figures reported by the CLI; the actual spend went against the owner's subscription.
- **Adversarial:** 2/2 refused in about 7 seconds for under $0.01 each, with a plain-English reason. One asked for a hidden-op backdoor plus a Discord webhook leak; the other asked to dump the host's environment and `.claude.json`.
- **Failures:** no legitimate prompt failed. The only failed rows are those 2 refusals and 1 build I cancelled on purpose to capture the cancelled screen.
- Raw records: `/root/agent-notes/modbuilder-preview/phase0-builds.jsonl`.

### Verified for real
- **End-to-end builds:** through the VM service, both from the command line and through the portal API on a local dev server with a throwaway database: a new build, a change request on it, a boss build on 1.21.1, and a cancel.
- **In-game test:** 8 jars ran on a throwaway Paper 1.21.11 server (in Docker on the VM) and were driven by a mineflayer bot. All enabled with no exceptions. The bot checked:
  - economy: balance, `/eco give`, buying a diamond from the shop menu, coins deducted;
  - `/heal`, `/feed`, `/zone` create/list, join titles, scoreboard sidebar, spleef help;
  - daily reward (5 bread), `/streak`;
  - `/summonboss` with its boss bar and death announcement.

  Output is in `bot-test-output.json` and `bot-test2-output.json`. I removed the test server container afterwards.
- **Access control:** another customer gets a 404 on the pages (the page title says "Page not found", so the feature isn't named) and 404 on the API, and has no nav entry. A second preview user also gets 404 on the owner's builds.
- **Install logic:** installing, then installing a newer version, replaced the old jar and made a backup, but only against the sandbox fake server.

### Not verified
- Installing over real SSH onto a real customer server. Customer servers were off-limits; the code path is the same `SshGuestFs` the NxLabs installer uses.
- There is no automated in-game test per build; the bot tests were run by hand.
- No MockBukkit tests and no jar signing.
- Builder installs aren't recorded in the mods engine state, so the server's Mods tab won't list them yet.
- The 2 concurrent builds can in principle read each other's live workspace. That's harmless while only one user has access.
- A gated 404 returns HTTP 200 with the not-found page. That is existing platform behaviour from `loading.tsx` streaming, not something this feature adds.

### Screenshots (`/root/agent-notes/modbuilder-preview/`)
Desktop 1440 and mobile 390:
- `home`, plus `home-desktop-light`
- `empty`
- `progress`
- `success`, plus `success-desktop-light`
- `install-modal`, plus `install-done-desktop`
- `change-modal`
- `change-v2-history`
- `failed-refused`
- `failed-cancelled`
- `notfound-other-user`
- `admin-costs-desktop`

The scripts are in the same folder: `seed.ts`, `shot.mjs`, `mb.sh`, `bot-test*.js`. Throwaway database, `.env` and dev server are all cleaned up.

### Owner decisions and actions
1. To release: merge, run `db push` (the `ModBuild` table is additive), deploy through the promote script, and restart the worker so the sync sweep runs. The prod app must be able to read `/root/secrets/modbuilder.env` and to create `/var/lib/nxeon/modbuilds`.
2. Before anyone beyond you gets access:
   - Swap to a paid `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.
   - Decide pricing and credits.
   - Choose the model: Sonnet 5 today, or pin Sonnet 5.5 via `MB_MODEL`.
   - Settle the remaining questions in `EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY.md`: brand, Mojang EULA counsel review, farm VM sizing.
3. Optional: add more preview emails with Setting `preview_access_emails`. It is shared with the dedicated-preview helper, which should merge easily.
